conf.description: z/OS ACF2/Top Secret security-admin-changes, syslog-leef: generic LEEF envelope decode only; per-attribute ECS mapping (CHANGE verb, elevated-authority flag, old/new value detail) is an open gap because Administration-category attribute names are not published, and whether old/new detail is even present in a given site's LEEF line is unknown without a captured sample.

conf.comment: syslog-leef. No fixed field list is published for this LEEF stream: CA Compliance Event Manager SIEM Action attribute names (or the zSecure process's) are set per site/event-category and not documented by the vendor (see work order fields_omitted). Per the brief's 'do not guess an unguessable field name' rule this pipeline decodes only the generic LEEF envelope - the LEEF: banner header and a generic name=value walk of the pipe-delimited extension - and does NOT attempt ECS field-specific mapping. This dataset's LEEF stream carries the Administration category; whether each one-line record even includes per-attribute old/new change detail depends on the site's chosen substitution variables, per the work order.

functions.description: Split the LEEF:1.0 header (version/vendor/product/product-version/event-id) from the extension per the work order's sample ('LEEF:1.0|...' followed by "|"-delimited key=value pairs).

Generically walk every key=value pair in the extension without assuming any attribute name, mirroring the CEF extension-walk pattern elsewhere in this catalog. Produces _leef_name_N/_leef_value_N pairs per match (iterations auto-suffixes N) - the analyst still has to map these to ECS once a real sample is captured.

Tag event.category from the dataset's own event_categories and event.dataset from the data stream name. The marker field records that field-specific ECS mapping for this LEEF stream is an open gap pending a captured sample (see README) - not a guess.

Fallback event time via Cribl's own heuristic against _raw. LEEF's devTime-style attribute would be the real source but its attribute name is one of the unpublished ones this pipeline deliberately does not guess.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
